extracted.intended_audience: eRA Commons users: signing officials (SOs), program directors/principal investigators (PD/PIs), and institutional grants administrators for NIH/AHRQ/VA/DOC awards
extracted.subtask_description: Procedural guidance for initiating, editing, routing, and submitting Prior Approval requests (No Cost Extension, Other Request, Withdrawal, Carryover, DMS, Change of PD/PI) and for creating and submitting Research Performance Progress Reports (RPPR) in eRA Commons. Specifies eligibility rules, required fields/documents, role-based permissions, and UI actions.

rubrics_metrics.name: Prior Approval request types and role permissions
rubrics_metrics.description: The Prior Approval module supports specific request types (Withdrawal, No Cost Extension, Other Request, Carryover, Change of PD/PI, DMS Request). Different roles have different capabilities: SOs can initiate, view, modify, and submit many request types; PIs can initiate certain requests (e.g., Withdrawal) but cannot submit; some request types (Other, DMS, Carryover, Change of PD/PI) appear only for SOs.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Use role-based navigation: PIs see only requests for their own applications; SOs see organization-wide requests. Where PIs cannot submit, they use the Route button to send to an SO.

rubrics_metrics.name: Initiating a Prior Approval Request
rubrics_metrics.description: To initiate: log into eRA Commons, navigate to the Prior Approval module, select request type from dropdown on landing page, click Go, then click Initiate for the appropriate grant listed as eligible.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Listed grants are those eligible for the selected request type; Help topics for each request type list eligibility criteria. SOs may narrow results via search; PIs use toggles to quickly filter.

rubrics_metrics.name: Searching and filtering Prior Approval requests
rubrics_metrics.description: SOs can use Search for Requests and Filter Table text to find organization requests; PIs can use three quick toggles to filter by status (In Progress PI, In Progress SO, Submitted to Agency).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Search criteria include Request ID, Request Type, Request Status, PI name (autocomplete), grant number parts, and submission date range. Use the Grid tool to change rows per page (default 25).

rubrics_metrics.name: No-Cost Extension (NCE) eligibility
rubrics_metrics.description: An SO can request an NCE if the award has less than 90 days remaining before the project period end date and is within 270 days after the end of the project period, and the award has not been closed.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: NCEs may not be submitted if they contain errors but can be submitted with warnings. NCE requests may not be submitted for grants for which closeout has begun.

rubrics_metrics.name: AHRQ NCE exception
rubrics_metrics.description: AHRQ recipients do not use the Prior Approval method to request an NCE and must use the Status module; AHRQ NCE terms differ from NIH.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: See No-Cost Extension (NCE) for AHRQ Grants topic for AHRQ-specific requirements and steps.

rubrics_metrics.name: File upload and required fields for requests
rubrics_metrics.description: All request detail screens require filling out fields marked with a red asterisk. File uploads use drag-and-drop or Browse; only one file is allowed per upload area and all uploaded documents must be PDF format.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: To view or remove an uploaded file use the three-dot ellipsis menu (View/Delete). If the wrong file is uploaded, delete it before uploading another. Some sections allow up to 10 supporting documents or multiple named uploads (see specific request guidance).

rubrics_metrics.name: Other Request eligibility (FDA vs NIH)
rubrics_metrics.description: Other Request is available only to SOs and is used differently by agency: for FDA awards it is a generic request type (all FDA grants eligible); for NIH awards its use is IC-dependent and should not be used to submit DMS Plan updates.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: NIH awardees should contact Grants Management Staff or Program Officer for when to use Other Request; use DMS Request type for DMS Plan updates.

rubrics_metrics.name: Other Request general instructions
rubrics_metrics.description: General steps: fill out all required fields (red asterisk), upload a single PDF file for document area (one file per area).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: All uploaded documents must be PDF format. Use the three-dot ellipsis to view/delete uploaded files.

rubrics_metrics.name: Withdrawal Request eligibility and process
rubrics_metrics.description: Both PIs and SOs may initiate a Withdrawal Request, but only an SO can submit it. Withdrawal of an error-free application before council requires a justification statement and allows up to 10 supporting documents.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Applications that have gone through council review or have statuses Awarded, Withdrawn, or Canceled will not be displayed as eligible. If there is a pending agency action, the system blocks withdrawal and instructs to submit to Division of Receipt and Referral. Automatic notifications sent to SO and PI upon approval.

rubrics_metrics.name: Carryover Request eligibility conditions
rubrics_metrics.description: To be eligible for a Carryover request: grant must be active (project period not ended), not have Expanded authority, request date within current budget period, and not be a Fellowship application.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Grantees with Expanded authority may carryover automatically; others must submit a Carryover request for GMS/PO review. The system warns if prior-year FFRs are outstanding or previously rejected and resubmitted.

rubrics_metrics.name: Carryover request documents and numeric field rules
rubrics_metrics.description: Carryover requires specific uploads and fields: Amount of Funds to be Carried Over (numeric, accepts numbers and period, up to two decimals), single PDF Explanation of Unobligated Balance, single PDF Detailed Budget, single PDF Scientific Justification. IC-specific document requests (Consortium Budget, Budget Justification, Expenditure Plan, Checklist Page) may also be required.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Request ID is system-generated. Ensure uploaded PDFs conform to limits (one file per upload area unless IC indicates otherwise).

rubrics_metrics.name: Carryover and No-Cost Extension combination rules
rubrics_metrics.description: If a grant is eligible for a No-Cost Extension when initiating a Carryover, the system offers the ability to also initiate an NCE. An NCE can be initiated if project period end date is within 90 days or has passed and grant is not in closeout or unilateral closeout.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Follow NCE eligibility rules when combining requests.

rubrics_metrics.name: DMS Request usage and eligibility
rubrics_metrics.description: DMS Request is available only to SOs and is used to submit revisions to approved Data Management and Sharing (DMS) plans off-cycle for NIH awards subject to the Final NIH DMS Policy.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Do not use Other Request for DMS changes; all uploaded documents must be PDFs.

rubrics_metrics.name: DMS Request required form fields and uploads
rubrics_metrics.description: Signing officials must supply Effective Date (current or future date only), Justification Document (rationale), Budget Document (if revised plan impacts budget), and Proposed DMS Plan Document (attach revised plan).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Attach PDFs for each item; Budget Document should include information for current and future budget periods. This is not a supplement request.

rubrics_metrics.name: Change of PD/PI eligibility
rubrics_metrics.description: Change of PD/PI can be initiated by an SO for grants meeting conditions: grant year is most recent awarded year in segment; grant family not past Project Period End Date; grant is not a Fellowship; IC/agency must support Change of PD/PI; Administrative Supplements cannot have a Change of PD/PI initiated; cannot be a multi-project grant.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: PD/PIs do not see Change of PD/PI option in Prior Approval module.

rubrics_metrics.name: Change of PD/PI allowed modifications and upload constraints
rubrics_metrics.description: On a Change of PD/PI request the reviewer can: add/remove PD/PI; mark Contact PD/PI; set level of effort (months or academic/summer, may not be zero); set Effective Date; provide Justification; assign leadership for MPI; upload Biographical Sketch Common Form (limit one PDF per PD/PI; cannot be flattened or modified once certified in SciENcv); upload Current and Pending Support Common Form (limit one PDF per PD/PI; cannot be flattened or modified once certified); upload Foreign Contract Document; upload Other Documents (up to 10, 6 MB per file); and IC-specific uploads.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: To add a PI type part of the name and select from the list limited to organization members. When specifying effort, enter either Calendar months (1–12) or Academic (1–9) and/or Summer (1–3) but not both calendar and academic/summer.

rubrics_metrics.name: Submitting, saving, canceling, and deleting requests
rubrics_metrics.description: Only an SO can submit an in-progress request to the agency; PIs see a Route button to route to an SO. Use Save to keep progress and return later. Cancel discards unsaved changes but does not delete the request. Delete removes the entire request after confirmation.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: On Submit, system validates required fields and documents; if errors appear, correct them and re-submit. On successful submit, system generates a PDF of the request (including uploaded docs), sends notifications (SO, GMS, PO), and stores the PDF in the electronic grant folder.

rubrics_metrics.name: Viewing request history
rubrics_metrics.description: Two methods: For in-progress requests, open the request and open the Request History section at bottom of screen. For submitted requests, search for 'Submitted to Agency' and select View History from three-dot ellipsis in search results.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Request History screen shows actions taken on the request.

rubrics_metrics.name: Routing and recalling Prior Approval requests
rubrics_metrics.description: Only Withdrawal requests can be routed. A PI can route a Withdrawal to the SO; an SO can route a request to a PI. Routing changes the current reviewer (the recipient can modify). A previously routed reviewer can recall the request; recalls are not allowed after the request status is 'Submitted to Agency'.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: To route, click Route on the Modify Request screen, optionally enter comments, then click Route to SO or Route to PI. Successful routing makes the request read-only to the previous reviewer; a Recall button is available on the read-only screen to recall.

rubrics_metrics.name: Three-dot ellipsis menu actions and grid tool usage
rubrics_metrics.description: Many actions (Initiate, Modify, View, View History, Delete, Download PDF) are available via the three-dot ellipsis menu next to Request ID or Award Number. The Grid tool controls number of rows displayed per page (default 25).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Use the three-dot menu to perform actions appropriate to the request status (e.g., Modify only for in-progress items; View for routed/submitted items).

rubrics_metrics.name: RPPR module features and submission flow
rubrics_metrics.description: RPPR module supports electronic initiation, routing for institutional review and approval, viewing routing history, error checking, electronic submission, creation/submission of Interim and Final RPPRs, and PDF generation stored in the electronic grant folder. SOs can delegate authority to a PD/PI to submit an RPPR (except for DOC awards where delegations cannot be used).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Field-by-field guidance for NIH/AHRQ/VA RPPRs is available in the NIH and Other PHS Agency RPPR Instruction Guide. Use the RPPR Menu to access functions for a specific award; due date appears on the RPPR Menu screen.

rubrics_metrics.name: RPPR initiation, editing, and validation rules
rubrics_metrics.description: Initiate button begins the RPPR for grants with status Not Started; PD/PIs and their delegates can initiate. The initiating PI becomes the current reviewer and can edit; only the current reviewer can edit when routed. The RPPR can be initiated even if some required Personal Profile or Institution Profile info is missing, but the RPPR will not pass validations for submission until errors are corrected.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: If profile information is incorrect or missing, prompts appear after initiating the report; processing may continue but submission will fail validation until corrections are made.

rubrics_metrics.name: Manage RPPR screen access differences
rubrics_metrics.description: The Manage RPPR screen shows a PI their Not Started or in-progress RPPRs; SOs can search for RPPRs across their organization. Use Awarding Office/IC button to limit searches by grantor organization. Click the grant number link in the Award Number column to open the RPPR Menu for processing.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: DOC awardees access RPPRs from the Status module rather than Manage RPPR; see DOC-specific instructions.
